description.en: Private notes for each project, next to your agents: write them, put one in your message, and let agents read or add to them
description.fr: Des notes privées pour chaque projet, à côté de vos agents : les écrire, en mettre une dans votre message, et laisser les agents les lire ou les compléter

tools.name: list
tools.description: Lists the user's private notes for this Squadron project: the id and title of each, pinned ones first and marked.

tools.name: read
tools.description: Reads one of the user's private notes for this Squadron project by its id, or all of them without an id.

id.description: The id of the note, as notes_list gives it. Leave it out to read every note.

tools.name: append
tools.description: Adds text at the end of one of the user's private notes for this Squadron project, or to a new note without an id. Use it only when the user asks you to note something.

text.description: The text to add, in Markdown.

id.description: The id of the note to add to, as notes_list gives it. Leave it out to start a new note, whose first line is its title.
